_about: Scripted lines for scenario 'walk-home'. Each entry is pre-rendered to public/audio/vo/<id>.mp3 by scripts/gen-voice.mjs. speaker: thought = her inner voice (close, quiet, tense); woman = her speaking aloud; man = the harasser; clerk = the shopkeeper; self = the bystander's own inner voice (text only, never voiced).

w_keys.speaker: thought
w_keys.text: Keys in my hand. Like always.

w_alley_2.speaker: thought
w_alley_2.text: It's a cat. It's just a cat. Breathe.

w_notice_1.speaker: thought
w_notice_1.text: There's a guy up ahead. Under the scaffolding.

w_notice_2.speaker: thought
w_notice_2.text: Don't look at him. Just walk.

w_notice_cross.speaker: thought
w_notice_cross.text: I could cross the street. Would that make it worse?

w_follow_2.speaker: thought
w_follow_2.text: Don't look back. Don't look back.

w_shop.speaker: thought
w_shop.text: The shop's still open. I could go in.

w_home_near.speaker: thought
w_home_near.text: If I go in now, he sees where I live.

w_home_2.speaker: thought
w_home_2.text: Tomorrow I'll go the long way round.

w_home_followed.speaker: thought
w_home_followed.text: He watched me go in. He knows which door is mine.

w_refuge_1.speaker: thought
w_refuge_1.text: Just stay in here. Wait until he's gone.

w_refuge_2.speaker: thought
w_refuge_2.text: How long do I wait? Is he still out there?

c_refuge.speaker: clerk
c_refuge.text: You okay, miss? That guy bothering you? Stay as long as you need.

c_refuge_alone.speaker: clerk
c_refuge_alone.text: Evening. You alright, miss? Cold one tonight.

w_refuge_alone_2.speaker: thought
w_refuge_alone_2.text: He's gone. Just breathe for a second.

c_help_1.speaker: clerk
c_help_1.text: Hey! Hey, leave her alone, man. I got cameras out here.

c_help_2.speaker: clerk
c_help_2.text: Keep walking, or I'm calling the cops. I mean it.

c_ask.speaker: clerk
c_ask.text: What's going on out there? Him? Yeah. Hold on.

b_m1.speaker: man
b_m1.text: Hey. Hey, beautiful. Where you headed?

b_m2.speaker: man
b_m2.text: I'm talking to you. What, you can't say hi?

b_m3.speaker: man
b_m3.text: Come on, slow down. Let me walk you home. Where you live at?

b_m4.speaker: man
b_m4.text: Damn, why you gotta be like that? I'm just being nice.

b_m5.speaker: man
b_m5.text: Stuck-up bitch. You think you're too good for me?

b_m6.speaker: man
b_m6.text: Yeah, keep walking! Nobody wants you anyway!

b_w1.speaker: woman
b_w1.text: I'm good, thanks. Have a good night.

b_w2.speaker: woman
b_w2.text: Please. I just want to get home.

s_4.speaker: self
s_4.text: There is no one else here. It's you.
